_comment: The cron-job.org jobs that fire the private repo's workflows (Nick's account; STATUS_2026-11-07; step 3b adds 'Afternoon tags'). The plan of record: scripts/actions_minutes.py counts the firings from it, and tests/test_tag_freshness.py pins the afternoon times to config live_refresh.afternoon_firings. Every job POSTs to https://api.github.com/repos/nickrolen/newsletter-state/actions/workflows/<workflow>/dispatches with four headers: Authorization: Bearer <the cron-job.org token>, Accept: application/vnd.github+json, X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28, Content-Type: application/json. Time zone America/Los_Angeles.
